name: v0.0.76
body:
## What's Changed
* Point package metadata at github.com/anthropics/sandbox-runtime by @shawnm-anthropic in https://github.com/anthropics/sandbox-runtime/pull/512
* cli: let srt exit after the command when --control-fd is a pipe by @ronleizrowice-ant in https://github.com/anthropics/sandbox-runtime/pull/501
* linux: drop a root caller's capabilities in both sandbox modes by @ronleizrowice-ant in https://github.com/anthropics/sandbox-runtime/pull/505
* linux: skip write-deny binds already covered by a read-only denied directory by @ronleizrowice-ant in https://github.com/anthropics/sandbox-runtime/pull/502
* Sanitize an unregistered attribution key in every violation producer by @ronleizrowice-ant in https://github.com/anthropics/sandbox-runtime/pull/513
* Refuse allow-listed hostnames that resolve to loopback, link-local or configured private ranges by @dannycochran in https://github.com/anthropics/sandbox-runtime/pull/522
* Release v0.0.76 by @shawnm-anthropic in https://github.com/anthropics/sandbox-runtime/pull/528

## New Contributors
* @dannycochran made their first contribution in https://github.com/anthropics/sandbox-runtime/pull/522

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/anthropics/sandbox-runtime/compare/v0.0.75...v0.0.76
